summary: Iteration 2: tested the permanent Driver ID / Vehicle ID feature end to end (backend + UI). New pytest suite: 23/23 passed. It covered city-based driver code generation (BLR/CHN/CBE/TPR), override format and uniqueness checks, the code staying locked on edit, vehicle create/edit/duplicate-registration (also with case and spacing changed), no delete endpoint, RBAC, vehicle and driver search (Driver ID, Vehicle ID, reg no with and without spaces, mobile, name), assignment history (old row ended, new row current, changed_by, reason), and transaction snapshots: old txns keep their vehicle_id and vehicle_no after the driver's vehicle is reassigned AND after the vehicle registration is edited. Also covered: rejecting a vehicle that another driver already has or that is inactive, reject → notification → resubmit with a different vehicle (audit 'Vehicle ID changed'), the self-approval block, pre-migration txns showing 'Vehicle ID not recorded', and all 5 transaction reports having Driver ID and Vehicle ID columns, with Excel export working. UI checks passed (Playwright, 1920x1080): admin Vehicle Management add/edit/search/duplicate toast/assign-driver (occupied vehicle message shown); admin Driver Management add driver with vehicle → BLR-D-008 auto, driver-form-code-locked disabled on edit, duplicate override toast; staff calendar search by BLR-D-003 / CHN-002 / 'TN 22 CD' showing Driver ID + current vehicle + reg; driver card code, vehicle id and reg; payment dialog driver code, current vehicle and payment-vehicle-select defaulting to the current vehicle; picking another vehicle stored BLR-012; Change vehicle dialog → assignment-history-table correct and the old day's txn still shows the old vehicle; accounts verification table and detail page (txn-driver-code / txn-vehicle-id / txn-vehicle-reg, plus 'Vehicle ID not recorded' for historical rows); UI resubmit with vehicle change gave the correct audit trail; Reports page for all 6 reports plus xlsx downloads; staff blocked from /vehicles. No 500s, and no backend errors in the logs.

minor.issue: A vehicle can be set to Inactive while a driver still has it as current_vehicle_id. There is no warning and nothing blocks it, so the driver keeps an inactive current vehicle.

vehicle_id is checked only for existence. Staff can record a payment against an Inactive vehicle or a vehicle currently assigned to another driver (the UI hides Inactive but shows other drivers' vehicles). This may be intended (the 'editable vehicle' requirement), but consider a warning or extra confirmation.

Driver ID override is not checked against the city prefix (e.g. city Chennai + override BLR-D-950 is accepted). There is also no unique DB index on drivers.driver_code or drivers.current_vehicle_id, so uniqueness relies only on app-level find_one checks, which can race.
A q made of only punctuation (e.g. '-') matches every vehicle because the reg_key regex falls back to '.'. Cosmetic.
Unassigning (vehicle_id null) a driver who has no vehicle returns the confusing message 'This vehicle is already assigned to the driver'.

ui_bugs.issue: Seen once, could not reproduce in 3 later runs: when the dialog was first opened right after picking a driver through the search, the 'Vehicle ID used for this payment' trigger looked empty (no BLR-011 label), although the value was set and the submitted txn stored the right vehicle. Likely a race: form.vehicle_id is set before the /vehicles options load into the Radix Select. Consider showing driver.current_vehicle_id as a fallback label, or loading vehicles before opening the dialog.

issues: Date fields use the browser's native <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker. The display format is also US-style, which doesn't match the 'DD Mon YYYY' format used elsewhere in an Indian app.
The current vehicle reg no is cut off ('BLR-012 · TEST UI …') in the 320px card next to the Change button. Consider wrapping it or showing the reg on its own line.
Has no Driver ID / Vehicle ID columns. It is a per-staff aggregate, so this is expected; mentioning it only because the request said 'all 6 reports'.

action_items: (Optional) Block or warn when setting a vehicle to Inactive while it is assigned to a driver
(Optional) Add unique/partial indexes on drivers.driver_code and drivers.current_vehicle_id (sparse/partial on non-null) to make uniqueness race-safe
(Optional) Check that the Driver ID override prefix matches the city
(Optional) PaymentDialog: show the current vehicle label in the select before the options load

Update the iteration-1 regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_rent_audit_api.py + test_rent_audit_sod.py: POST /transactions now requires vehicle_id, and driver create ignores vehicle_no, so those old tests (make_txn, the test_driver fixture asserting vehicle_no) will fail. They were not re-run in this iteration to avoid leaving undeletable TEST data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 970 lines; split the vehicles/assignments, transactions and reports sections into modules
create_txn id: 'TXN-' + (100001 + count + random%1000) can collide and falls back to the hex format; use the counters collection (as for codes) for sequential txn ids

migrate_ids runs on every startup. It is idempotent (it checks for driver_code and current_vehicle_id), but it sets current_vehicle_id: None for drivers missing the key. That is fine; just make sure new drivers always get the key (they do).
list_vehicles loads every driver with a vehicle per request; fine at this scale

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 low-priority flaky display glitch)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ drivers, vehicles, transactions, assignments and notifications during the tests. All of them were deleted by exact id afterwards (the pytest module fixture handles its own; the UI-created R39-DRV-1009, BLR-011/012, TXN-100705/100741 were removed manually). Audit log entries for those records remain, because audit logs are append-only. Counters advanced as designed (never reused): the next Bengaluru driver code is BLR-D-009 and the next BLR vehicle is BLR-013; CBE/TPR/CHN counters also advanced. No seed or user data was modified (Karthik Raja's payment dialog was only opened and cancelled).
